name: Rough Sprinkle
description: A pulse of qi runs down the arm as the fingers open and the star leaves with extra bite.

name: Toothbandage
description: Send a thin line of qi to the target and read the distance back through the fingertips.

name: Hubswat
description: Rake the spokes of a star held in the palm across the face of a foe stepping too near.

name: Springing Thinplate
description: Slide the lead foot sideways and the rear foot after it so a lunge finds only air.

name: Doughty Scatter
description: Qi packed behind a single point drives the star through leather and into the flesh beneath it.

name: Brisk Hail
description: Two stars leave the hand together on one pulse of qi and part slightly so each finds a different mark.

name: Swift Edgeface
description: Bend the wrist inward at release so the star leaves the line and slowly curls toward the target.

name: Ruthless Whiz
description: Pinch the star off center and let go so its unequal spin carries it in a gentle arc.

name: Whizslap
description: A smear of qi on one face of the star makes it bank sharply at the end of its flight.

name: Rude Flatpoint
description: Cut across the body from the shoulder to the hip with a spoke of the star held in the fist.

name: Cornerpoint Buckle
description: Meet a downward cut with the star turned edge-on so the blade skids off the rim of a spoke.

name: Spoke Swerve
description: Circle a post or pillar with short steps so the foe must keep turning to face the thrower.

name: Hubflog
description: Throw high and wide so the star bends down behind a raised shield and strikes the arm holding it.

name: Rushing Spray
description: A sharply curving throw drops the star past the raised blade and into the unguarded side.

name: Draught Rimpoint
description: Dip the hand into the belt pouch and come out already holding a star in throwing position.

name: Hubslap
description: Draw a star without looking down and throw while the eyes stay locked on the opponent.

name: Brass Tippoint
description: Whip the loose pouch strap across the face to cover a quick draw with a stinging slap.

name: Brass Hub
description: Hold the stiff pouch against the chest so a thrust lands on leather and star flats.

name: Clay Cornerpoint
description: Spin on the ball of one foot to face a new attacker without lifting the heel or losing balance.

name: Clay Centerhole
description: Empty a handful of stars from the pouch in one swing so a whole doorway is filled with points.

name: Rillhail
description: Roll clear of a swing and come up with a star already drawn and loosed back along the line.

name: Hum Spoke
description: Cut the wind-up away and flick the star straight from the ready hold in one quick motion.

name: Ember Hail
description: Snap the forearm forward with the elbow fixed at the shoulder for a short fast flat throw.

name: Hum Bladeface
description: Whip the star from the hip along the ground line at the shins of a charging foe.

name: Comet Whiz
description: Pull and loose a star without breaking the walking rhythm so the foe sees no preparation.

name: Draught Bladeface
description: Drag a spoke along the ribs of a foe who has closed inside the throwing distance.

name: Rill Rimpoint
description: Turn the wrist in a small circle so that an incoming thrust slides past on the star's flat.

name: Gritwhiz
description: Step diagonally outside a straight blow so the attacker's arm is across his own body.

name: Threefold Peppering
description: Five stars fly from one hand in a continuous run so each throw begins as the last leaves.

name: Grim Hub
description: Time a throw to leave the hand as the foe's guard opens for his own strike and slip it through.

name: Momentwhiz
description: Throw one star on each out-breath for a long steady stream that keeps a foe behind cover.

name: Honedwhiz
description: Catch a spoke on the inside of the wrist and pull to open the grip of a weapon hand.

name: Draught Thinplate
description: Flick a held point toward the brow so the foe blinks and loses the line of his own cut.

name: Brass Scatter
description: Let a spoke ride the length of the enemy blade and bite the fingers behind the guard.

name: Shard Flatpoint
description: Rotate the star a half turn in the fingers and throw it with a spoke leading.

name: Guarding Centerhole
description: Hold the star low and forward with the spokes spread to catch a kick or a sweeping staff.

name: Grit Edgeface
description: Scoot backward on the balls of both feet while the held spokes keep the foe at arm's length.

name: Stamptooth
description: Hook a spoke into the foe's sleeve and haul so his weapon arm is dragged off its line.

name: Honedtooth
description: A qi-edged spoke parts a rope strap or bowstring in a single clean draw.

name: Omen Sprinkle
description: Hook then rake then jab with the held star in one quick run against a foe too close to avoid it.

name: Gleam Peppering
description: Release in the moment the lead foot lands so the stride adds speed instead of shaking the aim.

name: Tippoint Hammerfall
description: Spin half around and send the star back over the shoulder at a pursuer.

name: Gleam Whiz
description: Skip backward off one foot and flick a star forward as the body is in the air.

name: Sleet Flatpoint
description: Take a long sidestep and snap the star out level at the moment the weight settles.

name: Brutal Hail
description: Run across open ground loosing a star every few strides to keep an archer or spearman pinned.

name: Grithail
description: Slide low across the ground below a volley and loose a star from the crouch at its source.

name: Sprigtooth
description: Send a star through the loose sleeve of a foe and into a post behind it to tether the arm.

name: Rimpoint Barrier
description: Throw low through the hem of a long robe into the floor so a stride is cut short.

name: Whizscreen
description: Nail the edge of a fleeing cloak to a doorframe so the wearer is yanked up short.

name: Hubtonic
description: Brace the thumb against the fingers and steady the star against a still breath before the pin.

name: Staticspoke
description: Open a hand that seizes the throwing arm by raking spokes across its back.

name: Veering Spoke
description: Move off the line the foe is facing so that his pinned side cannot turn to follow.

name: Gall Scatter
description: A qi-sharp star drives through the back of a weapon hand and fixes it to wood.

name: Clutching Cornerpoint
description: Pin the toe of a boot to the ground with one throw so the next step comes late.

name: Rugged Centerhole
description: Aim a thin flat throw at the narrow eye slit of a helm and loose it level.

name: Ember Peppering
description: Flick a star at the buckle or strap seam where two plates of armor meet.

name: Hailswat
description: Throw a weighted star point-first with a full body swing to dent thin plate.

name: Edgeface Scorer
description: Work a held spoke into a gap in armor and lever it open with a quick twist.

name: Toothhasp
description: Slide off the grip of an armored arm by turning the wrist against the thumb.

name: Thinplate Flog
description: Qi packed hard in one point lets the star split the rings of a mail shirt and wound beneath.

name: Keen Bladeface
description: Throw a thin star at the lifted elbow of a plated arm where the joint leaves the bare gap.
